This is a demonstration of an annual selection spanning film, music, and opera. It does not rank works or imply personal favourites. Its coverage year is 2025; its publication date is in 2026.

## Film

A selection might pair the title and creator with a paragraph about why the work belongs here. It can link to an earlier log or a longer review without reproducing either entry.

## Music

For recordings, identify the artist or performers and the edition where relevant. Different interpretations of the same work can have separate entries.

## Opera

A production or performance needs more than the title of the opera. Company, venue, date, conductor, and cast can help identify the particular encounter, whenever that information is supplied.

## Ranked or unranked

This example is unranked. A top-ten article can use a numbered list instead, with one heading and a short explanation for each selection. No selections have been invented for this demonstration.
